title: Signs You Stopped Growing - TallPlan Remake
summary: Debunks the stomach hair height myth and presents physical signs of growth plate closure, steering users to calculate their growth potential in TallPlan.
style: Modern 2D anime-influenced webcomic animation, clean bold line art, cel shading, bright studio lighting, neutral gradient backgrounds, vibrant mint green VFX highlights.
character: 15-year-old teenage boy with messy dark brown hair, expressive dark eyes, athletic lean build, wearing black athletic shorts.
character_prompt: Full-body side profile of a 15-year-old teenage boy, messy dark hair, athletic build, wearing black athletic shorts, barefoot, neutral standing pose, clean 2D anime illustration, crisp cel shading, solid light grey background, single person, no text.

keyframes.name: kf_stomach_hair
keyframes.prompt: Extreme close-up shot of an athletic teenage torso showing pronounced stomach hair around the navel, sharp cel shading, anime aesthetic, no head or face visible, mint green arrow graphic pointing downward.

keyframes.name: kf_jawline_reveal
keyframes.prompt: Close-up front angle of a teenage boy showing a sharp, pronounced square jawline with a confident smile, glowing mint green outline accentuating jaw structure, stylized anime aesthetic.

keyframes.name: kf_growth_hologram
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot of a teenage boy standing beside a glowing mint-green holographic height ruler, looking upward thoughtfully, soft studio background, anime illustration style.

base.shots:
0-3s: Macro shot of torso with stomach hair, camera tilts down rapidly, mint green glowing pointer appears. [SFX: Whoosh, digital click]
3-7s: Fast pull-out to teen looking frustrated beside a height bar; he punches upwards, shattering a glowing barrier into mint particles. [SFX: Impact smash, glass shatter]
7-10s: Glowing numbers 1-2-3 orbit character as camera pushes in to a dramatic close-up of a sharp jawline with glowing mint outline. [SFX: Fast swoosh, chime riser]
base.vo: Having stomach hair early means your growth is stunted? Completely false. Here are real signs your growth plates might be closing.

ext.shots:
0-3s: Cut to translucent full-body silhouette with glowing mint hormonal nodes shifting from spine to facial bones. [SFX: Deep hum, digital pulse]
3-5.5s: Teen stands thoughtfully as glowing mint holographic measurement lines trace his stature. [SFX: Shimmer, rising tone]
5.5-8s: Low-angle medium-wide shot; teen points upward toward empty upper-middle space, holding pose as mint sparkle radiates. [SFX: Pop, light chime]
ext.vo: A defined jawline indicates hormone shifts. Check your growth plate status and potential in TallPlan.

voice: Male, early 20s, North American accent, confident, educational, clear energetic delivery, ~150 WPM, crisp broadcast vocal tone.
music: Mid-tempo modern hip-hop beat with punchy 808s, light synthesizer melodies, and a clean forward groove.

qa_checks.character: Consistent anime teen boy with messy dark hair and black gym shorts across all scenes.
qa_checks.no_text: Zero alphanumeric text or labels generated in the frame.
qa_checks.pose: Standard standing, punching upward, and pointing gestures without unnatural posture.
qa_checks.anatomy: Close-ups tightly framed on abdomen or jawline without headless neck stumps or warped limbs.
qa_checks.voice: VO strictly under word limits, pacing matches reference, final sentence finishes with 'in TallPlan.'
